statements.text: Keep twig length, dye, and start time the same; change only the water temperature.
Judge the faster condition by which twig shows the colour higher up sooner.
Use a short twig in warm water and a long twig in cold water so temperature is tested fairly.

stem:
Arnav wants a fair test of whether warm or cold conditions change how fast water moves up a plant twig in coloured water.

Which statements help design that fair test?

teacher.key_rationale: A fair test holds length, dye, and start time fixed and varies only temperature; earlier colour rise shows faster transport. Unequal twig lengths spoil the temperature comparison, so 1 and 2 only.
